title: Campus Outdoor Ceremony with Orchestra, 1966 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot stamped 'MAR • 66' on the white border, capturing an outdoor formal gathering or commencement ceremony. In the foreground, musicians sit with their backs to the camera behind music stands holding sheet music. In the midground, a speaker stands at a podium under an elongated awning canopy before seated dignitaries and attendees, with a mid-century modernist pillared institutional or university building set amid leafy trees in the background.
